preconditions.description: The input is a single non-empty line containing a word of length between 1 and 100, composed of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in stdout.strip()) or all(c.isupper() for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: The output is the same word as input but with all letters either lowercase or uppercase, depending on the original case distribution.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.isupper()) > sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.islower()) == (all(c.isupper() for c in stdout.strip()))
postconditions.description: If the input word has strictly more uppercase letters than lowercase letters, the output is all uppercase; otherwise, the output is all lowercase.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == stdin.strip().lower() if sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.isupper()) <= sum(1 for c in stdin.strip() if c.islower()) else stdin.strip().upper()
postconditions.description: The output is the input word converted to lowercase if the number of uppercase letters is less than or equal to the number of lowercase letters; otherwise, it is converted to uppercase.
